_help: Ayatul Kursi images (002). Same format as 001: start = spoken line it first appears on, or 'ayah' = from that Arabic block's swoosh (AYAH 1 = whole ayah, AYAH 2..11 = jumla 1..10). reuse_id = an image already in this story (free crop/zoom, optional rect). 12 new images, prompts = places/sky/light/lamps only, simple and concrete so a FREE flux-class model can draw them (scripts/cf_image.py, free first; the builder adds the style block). Every new prompt ends 'No people, no text, no writing'. Never any Prophet/Sahabi/angel/person, never a throne or a depiction of Allah, no domes/minarets/modern buildings.
